title: Inactivity timeout
description: Implement SCHC inactivity timeout handling. Acceptance: detects stale fragment streams, cleans up resources.
close_reason: Implemented exact 60-second SCHC inactivity expiry in Python/Rust: malformed/invalid activity cannot refresh leases, explicit multi-session cleanup retains Receiver-Abort tombstones, late fragments are rejected, and monotonic regression/overflow fail closed. Canonical schc_fragmentation timeout value is consumed by both implementations. Focused Python 239 passed; Rust all-features, no_std check, clippy -D warnings, rustfmt, and ruff passed.
